summary: Retest of IA Tesoureira after iteration_152 fixes - ALL CRITICAL BUGS RESOLVED. Logged in as admin@empresa.com, navigated to Financeiro > IA Tesoureira (data-testid='treasury-panel' rendered). On AGUARDA CTO row pay-demo-53366b336a (Fornecedora Fibras Ópticas LTDA R$1.850,00): (1) Approve → 200 POST /approve body={ok:true,new_status:'approved'}, status pill flipped to APROVADO, Enviar ao Asaas Sandbox button appeared, no CRA overlay, no inline error. (2) Send → 200 POST /send body={ok:false,asaas:{ok:false,error:'asaas_key_missing',message:'ASAAS_API_KEY ausente...'}}, status flipped to FALHOU, ULTIMO ERRO showing asaas_key_missing message inline, NO 500 and NO CRA overlay. (3) AI Review → 200 POST /ai-review, decision reloaded (REQUER CTO, risk 0). (4) Cancel → 200 POST /cancel, status became CANCELADO, audit timeline shows payment_cancelled event. History tab (treasury-history-table) and Forecast tab (treasury-forecast-view) both render correctly. Zero uncaught page errors, zero JWT/ASAAS_API_KEY value leaks in console.

minor.issue: SSE stream returns 401 (token in URL works initially but log shows recurring 401 unrelated to treasury flow). Not blocking but noisy. Investigate session refresh for EventSource.

critical_code_review_comments: TreasuryPanel.jsx is now 868 lines - recommend splitting PaymentDetailModal, PaymentsTable, ForecastView into separate files for maintainability (non-blocking).

Note: app overrides window.confirm with a custom dialog component (data-testid='dialog-backdrop' + 'Confirmar' button). This works correctly but is non-obvious - consider documenting in component README, or replacing with a controlled in-app modal in PaymentDetailModal for predictability.
asaas_client.py graceful degradation pattern (_AsaasNoKey -> {ok:false,error:'asaas_key_missing'}) is correctly applied to all 5 endpoints. Good defensive coding.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (3 payees + 8 payments). Tested on pay-demo-53366b336a (Fornecedora Fibras Opticas LTDA R$1.850, infraestrutura, pending_human_approval).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_152 HIGH bugs CONFIRMED FIXED. Approve flow no longer 422s (frontend sends fixed reason 'Aprovado via UI pelo CTO'). Send no longer 500s when ASAAS_API_KEY missing (returns {ok:false,error:'asaas_key_missing'} gracefully and modal shows inline ULTIMO ERRO). doAction wrapped in try/catch with setActionError state + data-testid='treasury-action-error' rendering when applicable (was empty in happy path since /send returned 200 not error). Custom confirm dialog requires clicking data-testid='dialog-backdrop' >> button 'Confirmar' to advance (not native window.confirm). No further retest needed for this scope.
